breakdown.description: The buoyantSimpleFoam solver is chosen for a buoyancy-driven flow, but the gravity vector is set to zero, which eliminates the buoyancy force entirely.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that a buoyancy-driven flow requires a non-zero gravity vector. It changed the gravity from zero to a standard value of (0 0 -9.81) m/s², which resolves the contradiction.
